quotes.text: An app can only connect to data sources that live in the same environment. If you build an app in one environment and the data sits in another, the app can't see it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the single boundary rule that explains most beginner connection problems.

quotes.text: Being allowed to build in an environment isn't the same as being allowed to read its data, and those are two separate doors.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies the common confusion between maker rights and data access.

quotes.text: A solution carries the structure of your app and not your business data, so your records stay behind in their own environment.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains concisely what moves between environments during ALM.

quotes.text: Connectors in the same group can share data and connectors in different groups can't. That's what stops a personal account from quietly pulling from a business system.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes how data policies prevent data leakage.

quotes.text: The biggest one is to stop treating the default environment as your production home. Rename it until its name says what it is and keep it for quick personal experiments.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a concrete, actionable best practice.

chapters.title: Why the default environment is a trap

takeaways: An app can only reach data sources in its own environment, so many broken connections are boundaries rather than bugs.
Use the default environment only for personal experiments, build in developer or sandbox environments and ship managed solutions to production.
Maker rights and data access are separate, and data policies, environment groups and Managed Environments add tenant-wide guardrails.
hook: Every licensed user can build in the default environment, yet Microsoft says not to run production work there. This episode explains Power Platform environments, types, Dataverse, roles and governance in plain words for makers and admins. You will know which environment to build in and why.
